title: City Council Approves River Plan
excerpt: A long-awaited restoration plan passed on Tuesday.
textContent: After months of public meetings, the city council approved a detailed plan to restore the river, rebuild wetlands, and improve paths along the eastern bank. Residents filled the chamber on Tuesday, while planners described how the work would reduce flooding and create new habitat.The first phase begins this autumn and includes native tree planting, removal of abandoned concrete, and construction of two pedestrian bridges. Officials said the work will proceed in sections so that at least one riverside path remains open throughout construction.Community groups welcomed the vote, but asked the council to publish quarterly water-quality measurements. The mayor agreed, saying that transparent reports would help residents understand whether the investment is producing the promised environmental benefits.
content:
After months of public meetings, the city council approved a detailed plan to restore the river, rebuild wetlands, and improve paths along the eastern bank. Residents filled the chamber on Tuesday, while planners described how the work would reduce flooding and create new habitat.

The first phase begins this autumn and includes native tree planting, removal of abandoned concrete, and construction of two pedestrian bridges. Officials said the work will proceed in sections so that at least one riverside path remains open throughout construction.

Community groups welcomed the vote, but asked the council to publish quarterly water-quality measurements. The mayor agreed, saying that transparent reports would help residents understand whether the investment is producing the promised environmental benefits.
